subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After the correctness blockers are repaired, should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, Gateway, and plugin SDK status, or should yielded-parent waiting remain internal and project through existing public statuses?
rationale: The branch expands persisted and external lifecycle contracts; code correctness and tests cannot determine the intended long-term compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Preserve existing public status contracts and represent yielded-parent descendant handoff as internal lifecycle state.

options.title: Adopt Deferred Publicly
options.body: Make `deferred` permanent only with explicit upgrade, protocol, SDK, CLI, UI, and third-party consumer guarantees.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public status contracts and represent yielded-parent descendant handoff as internal lifecycle state.

likelyOwner.reason: This direction extends the yielded lifecycle behavior introduced in commit 6f3b5f8666f3a3877b62d9019b8842455fdf62e1.
